records.name: DeepSWE 1.1 / benchmark-owner harness
records.citationNote: 113 tasks, shared mini-swe-agent, bash access and prompt. Current owner leaderboard; error bars are retained without inventing a confidence level or total attempt count. Version 1.1 release date is documented in the owner changelog. Separate from Artificial Analysis and provider runs.

records.name: Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index 1.5
records.citationNote: Independent evaluator. Equal-weight DeepSWE 1.1 (113 tasks), Terminal-Bench 4.0 (66) and SWE Atlas Codebase QnA (124), each with three attempts per task. Scores compare native agent configurations. Version is established by current methodology plus the dated article components, not an invented exact release day.

records.name: SWE Atlas Codebase QnA / Scale native agents
records.citationNote: 124 tasks from 11 production repositories. All rubric criteria must pass, with Opus 4.5 as judge. Sample count is tasks; total trials are not asserted from another evaluator methodology. Definition validFrom denotes first observation in this catalog, not benchmark launch.

records.name: SWE Atlas Test Writing / Scale native agents
records.citationNote: 90 tasks, three trials per task. Manifest, mutation-test and rubric checks determine resolution; Opus 4.5 judges rubric checks. The page records a July 28 dataset/harness update, not publication of September model rows. Definition validFrom denotes first observation in this catalog, not benchmark launch.

records.name: SWE Atlas Refactoring / Scale native agents
records.citationNote: 70 tasks from 10 production repositories. Existing tests and all required rubrics must pass; Opus 4.5 judges rubric checks. Total attempts and CI level not established. No Opus 5 result was present. Definition validFrom denotes first observation in this catalog, not benchmark launch.

records.name: Terminal-Bench 2.1 / Artificial Analysis
records.citationNote: Historical independent AA measurements. Keep separate from the Terminal-Bench owner leaderboard and newer TB4 runs. Exact historical harness revision and attempt count are not supplied in the launch articles.

records.name: CodeRabbit / overall actionable bug coverage
records.citationNote: Labeled issues found through actionable comments. Same article comparison only; not overall review quality. Different overall and cross-file denominators. No precision, issue/PR count, effort, exact pipeline version or uncertainty intervals published.

records.name: CodeRabbit / cross-file actionable bug coverage
records.citationNote: Labeled issues found through actionable comments. Same article comparison only; not overall review quality. Different overall and cross-file denominators. No precision, issue/PR count, effort, exact pipeline version or uncertainty intervals published.

records.name: CodeRabbit Opus 5 senior / actionable known-issue coverage
records.citationNote: Share of 96 known error patterns caught by an actionable comment; averaged across three repeats. Article and visually inspected table. Counts are evaluation patterns, not a published PR sample size. Different CodeRabbit publication snapshots are not a common leaderboard.

records.name: CodeRabbit Opus 5 senior / full-stream known-issue coverage
records.citationNote: Share of known error patterns caught in any post-pipeline comment class, including outside-diff and low-confidence nitpicks. Article and visually inspected table. Counts are evaluation patterns, not a published PR sample size. Different CodeRabbit publication snapshots are not a common leaderboard.

records.name: CodeRabbit Opus 5 senior / actionable comment precision
records.citationNote: Share of actionable post-pipeline comments accepted by the evaluation judge. Comment denominator differs from the known-issue coverage denominator. Article and visually inspected table. Counts are evaluation patterns, not a published PR sample size. Different CodeRabbit publication snapshots are not a common leaderboard.

records.name: CodeRabbit Opus 5 senior / full-stream comment precision
records.citationNote: Share accepted after every scored post-pipeline comment class is included. Do not substitute actionable precision for this noisier stream. Article and visually inspected table. Counts are evaluation patterns, not a published PR sample size. Different CodeRabbit publication snapshots are not a common leaderboard.

records.name: CodeRabbit Fable 5.1 low setting / known-issue recall
records.citationNote: Share of the 105 known-issue points with at least one valid comment. Low/High are internal experiment labels; API reasoning effort is not specified. Keep configurations separate when grouping unspecified-effort cells.

records.name: CodeRabbit Fable 5.1 low setting / processed comment precision
records.citationNote: Share of final post-pipeline comments judged valid; not a claim about all possible code defects. Low/High are internal experiment labels; API reasoning effort is not specified. Keep configurations separate when grouping unspecified-effort cells.

records.name: CodeRabbit Fable 5.1 high setting / known-issue recall
records.citationNote: Share of the 105 known-issue points with at least one valid comment. Low/High are internal experiment labels; API reasoning effort is not specified. Keep configurations separate when grouping unspecified-effort cells.

records.name: CodeRabbit Fable 5.1 high setting / processed comment precision
records.citationNote: Share of final post-pipeline comments judged valid; not a claim about all possible code defects. Low/High are internal experiment labels; API reasoning effort is not specified. Keep configurations separate when grouping unspecified-effort cells.

records.name: CodeRabbit Sol / actionable known-issue coverage
records.citationNote: 69 of 99 known issues caught actionably. Different issue counts, prompts, judges and pipeline snapshots prevent cross-article ranking. Effort and PR sample count not published.

records.name: CodeRabbit Sol / actionable comment precision
records.citationNote: Share of actionable comments correct enough to keep; the separately stated 231 comments are RAW model output before filtering. Different issue counts, prompts, judges and pipeline snapshots prevent cross-article ranking. Effort and PR sample count not published.

records.version: light-v1 / kodus dev / vendor defaults / scored 2026-08-13
records.name: CodeReviewBench light-v1 / micro recall
records.citationNote: Distinct golden bugs matched divided by 95 known bugs. Original scorecard ratio scale 0-1; not all possible defects. One replay per model.

records.version: light-v1 / kodus dev / vendor defaults / scored 2026-08-13
records.name: CodeReviewBench light-v1 / micro precision
records.citationNote: Judge tpFindings divided by all scored findings, micro-aggregated across 30 PRs. Original ratio 0-1. Matching judge is Haiku 4.5; not execution verification or independent human adjudication. Golden comments may be incomplete.

records.name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
records.citationNote: Version 4.3.2 first observed on the live model pages September 25; introduction date unknown. Keep separate from earlier index versions.

records.name: AA Intelligence Index v5
records.citationNote: A composite of nine evaluations: 25% knowledge work, 25% coding, 25% science, 25% general. 60% of the weight runs on private or held-out test sets.

records.name: ARC-AGI-2 Semi-Private
records.citationNote: Abstract visual puzzles that resist memorisation. ARC Prize verifies scores on a hidden set and publishes cost per task.

records.name: DeepSWE
records.citationNote: Long-horizon software tasks written from scratch across 91 repositories, scored by hand-written verifiers. The same mini agent harness runs every model.

records.name: Terminal-Bench 4.0, native agents
records.citationNote: Agents complete command-line tasks in a sandbox, checked by test suites. Each row runs in its vendor's native agent.

records.name: OSWorld 2.0, partial credit
records.citationNote: 108 long computer-use workflows across 31 websites and desktop apps, about 318 tool calls each. Credit is given per checkpoint.

records.name: OSWorld-Verified
records.citationNote: 369 desktop and web tasks in real apps, about 30 tool calls each, checked by the final application state.

records.name: ExploitBench (V8)
records.citationNote: Can an agent turn patched V8 bugs into stronger exploit capability, from reaching the code to full control, across 16 flags.

records.name: CyScenarioBench (Irregular)
records.citationNote: Multi-stage cyber operations under realistic constraints. Measures sequencing of techniques, not isolated tricks. A 10-challenge subset, with cyber mitigations off.

records.name: CyberGym
records.citationNote: 1,507 known vulnerabilities in 188 projects. The agent writes a proof-of-concept that reproduces each bug.

records.name: Text Arena (arena.ai)
records.citationNote: Blind pairwise preference from 9 million human votes on open chat. It captures how a reply reads, not whether it is correct.

records.name: ExtractBench Pro, perfect documents
records.citationNote: 100 synthetic long-tail documents, 2,622 pages. A document only counts when every single value matches.

records.name: ExtractBench Pro, value F1
records.citationNote: The same runs as the perfect-document board, but counting each extracted value on its own.

records.name: GDPval-AA v2.1
records.citationNote: 220 real professional deliverables across 44 occupations, graded by blind pairwise comparison. Human expert work is pinned at 1000 Elo.

records.name: Chartography, no tools
records.citationNote: Professional chart understanding from Surge AI. Without tools, the model has to read the image itself.

records.name: MMMU (Vals AI)
records.citationNote: Multiple-choice questions over images across many academic disciplines.

records.name: Token Economy pilot: code review
records.citationNote: Our own pilot. Two small C# files hold ten seeded contract defects. Terra medium and Sol xhigh both found 10 of 10, Sol medium found 9 of 10.

records.name: Token Economy pilot: HTML UI
records.citationNote: Our own pilot. Two self-contained UI pages, graded 75% by a blinded screenshot jury and 25% by deterministic checks.

records.name: CodeRabbit known-bug coverage
records.citationNote: Share of labelled bugs caught with actionable comments in CodeRabbit's pipeline.
